launch_site: Unknown — unofficial LC-39A NET 10 Dec now uncertain; Starbase repeat possible
window_note: Flight 15 is complete (13–14 Nov 2026, Pad 2). SpaceX has not published Flight 16 date, pad, or official vehicles.

items.title: Flight 15 launch and recovery
items.detail: Liftoff 22:47:36 UTC from Pad 2. Ship 42 caught at tower (first upper-stage catch). Booster 22 catch aborted; offshore FTS.

items.title: Expected stack B-23 / S-43

items.title: Pad selection
items.detail: Unofficial first launch from LC-39A (NET 10 Dec 2026) is in doubt after NASASpaceflight 19 Nov reporting. Flight 16 may repeat from Starbase Pad 2.
